# 部執異論

**ID:** T2033
**Volume:** T49
**Category:** 史傳部類
**Original Category:** 史傳部
**Byline:** 天友菩薩造  陳 真諦譯
**Dynasty:** 陳
**Date:** 547–569
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T2033

## Contributors
- 天友 (A000143)
- 真諦 (A000962)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The second Chinese rendering, by [真諦](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9C%9F%E8%AB%A6) (Paramārtha) under the Chén 陳 dynasty, of the same *Samayabheda* doxographic tradition that he had previously translated as the *Shíbā bù lùn* ([KR6r0009](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0009)) and which Xuánzàng later re-translated as [KR6r0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0007). The Taishō (T49 no. 2033) attributes the work to 天友 (Tiānyǒu) — a name that has been variously identified as a translation of "Devamitra" or simply as an alternative epithet of Vasumitra (世友 → 天友 by minor graphic / semantic variation). The traditional view is that it is the work of [世友](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%96%E5%8F%8B) (Vasumitra) under a different name.

**Abstract**

The structure parallels the other two Chinese versions: a narrative of the post-Aśokan schism into Sthavira and Mahāsāṃghika with their subsequent sub-divisions, followed by a catalog of distinctive doctrinal theses for each school. Internal differences from [KR6r0009](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0009) are substantial enough that modern scholars (Bareau, Lamotte) have argued that the two are translations of *different recensions* of the underlying Indic work, not two attempts at the same original.

Paramārtha's translation activity in southern China dates to 546–569; the *Bù zhí yì lùn* is conventionally placed in his Chén-period output (557–569). The attribution of authorship to 天友 in the colophon, combined with the differences from [KR6r0009](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0009), has been the principal evidence used in argument for a separate Indic source. Like [KR6r0009](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0009), the work was largely superseded by [KR6r0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0007) but retained canonical status because of its independent witness value.
